scope: Proposition 4.2 (Pair mass in finite scale bands) of the manuscript “The entropy-rate dimension formula for self-similar measures on the line” (preprints/The-entropy-rate-dimension-formula-for-self-similar-measures-on-the-line-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 148 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a09f48f43c415392), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the assumptions and notation of Lemma 4.1, there exist c > 0 and an integer n0 such that, for each n ≥ n0, there is a deterministic finite integer Bn ≥ an satisfying E ⎡ ⎣1En Bn ∑︂ ℓ=an cℓ(νω,n) ⎤ ⎦ ≥ cn. (4.12) Here cℓ(ν) is the maximum total weight of fair two-point laws with separations in [2−ℓ, 21−ℓ) whose weighted sum is a submeasure of ν, as in Lemma 3.2. The constants b, A, A′, c, n0 are independent of n and ω; no growth bound on Bn is asserted.
